notes: Source: Sharma et al., Cureus 2023;15(3):e36317, SGRD Amritsar, North India. Only K. pneumoniae studied (82 ETA isolates from mechanically ventilated ICU/VAP patients: 40 in Jan-Jun 2018, 42 in Jan-Jun 2022). Data taken from Table 2 (page 3), 'Antibiotic sensitivity pattern in 2018 and 2022', which reports n(%) SENSITIVE — these are %S values, extracted directly (from_R=false throughout). Returned as two organism entries (one per year). Column values verified as susceptibility (not resistance): confirmed against page 4 narrative (e.g. colistin sensitivity 92%->28%, meropenem 15%->2.5%, minocycline 67%->100%). Notable: colistin decline is the study's headline finding; XDR rose 62.5%->71% (from Table 3, page 4). Non-canonical drug tokens used: cefoperazonesulbactam (Cfs, printed abbrev; a combination not in the canonical cefoperazone entry), nalidixicacid. Minocycline 2018 count printed oddly as '26.8 (67%)'; used the 67%. TMP-SMX 2022 printed only as 50% with no isolate count. Ampicillin noted 100% resistant (0% S) both periods in narrative but NOT a row in Table 2, so omitted to avoid fabricating a table cell. No ESBL%/MRSA% figures reported; MDR/XDR classification counts are in Ta
